features.feature: New / Open / Open Recent / Close / Save / Save As / Duplicate / Rename / Move To / Revert
features.apple: Edit.nib: File menu (New, Open…, Open Recent, Close, Save, Save As…, Duplicate, Revert to Saved)
features.note: SDK DocumentController::file_menu (springboard/sdk/src/document.rs:822) supplies the standard items.

features.apple: Edit.nib: File > Save All
features.note: File > Save All (cmd+alt+s) saves every edited document; untitled ones each open their save panel. Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add "Save All" to file_menu (main.rs:668) iterating self.docs open documents and calling the controller save for each edited one.

features.apple: Info.plist CFBundleDocumentTypes: RTF (Editor)
features.note: RTF subset: fonts, char + paragraph formatting, tab width.

features.apple: Info.plist CFBundleDocumentTypes: plain text (Editor)
Info.plist CFBundleDocumentTypes: HTML (Editor)
features.note: Read and write via html.rs.

features.apple: Info.plist: RTFD (Editor); Localizable: RTFD save notices
features.note: Pictures are skipped by the RTF reader (rtf.rs:6).
features.wire: Add an RTFD package reader/writer (folder with TXT.rtf + attachments) in a new rtfd.rs; needs an inline image cell kind in text.rs and drawing in view.rs; register the type in document.rs.

features.feature: Word .docx / .doc / Word XML / ODT / web archive
features.apple: Info.plist CFBundleDocumentTypes: Word 2007/2003 XML/97, OpenDocument Text, Web archive
features.note: .docx and .odt open and save (paragraphs, runs, bold/italic/underline/strike, size, colour, highlight, baseline, font family, alignment, spacing, lists) through a ZIP reader/writer (zipdoc.rs). Not carried: pictures, tables, headers/footers, comments, styles.xml defaults; .doc, Word XML and web archive are still missing.
features.wire: Start with .docx and .odt (zip + XML): new docx.rs/odt.rs mapping paragraphs, runs (b/i/u, font, size, colour) and alignment to text.rs cells; add types in document.rs read/write.

features.feature: Plain text encodings (open/save encoding accessory, customize list)
features.apple: EncodingAccessory.nib, SelectEncodingsPanel.nib; Localizable: encoding errors, Customize Encodings List
features.note: Plain text is UTF-8 only.
features.wire: Add an encoding popup to the open/save panels via SDK panel accessory (or a Format > Text Encoding submenu); decode/encode UTF-16/Latin-1/MacRoman in document.rs.

features.apple: Edit.nib: File > Export as PDF…
features.note: File > Export as PDF... asks through a save panel and writes the same PDF the printer gets (main.rs export_event). Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add File > Export as PDF… in file_menu (main.rs:668) that runs print.rs PDF generation and writes it through ctx.save_document with public.pdf.

features.apple: Edit.nib: File > Page Setup…, Print…; PrintAccessory: header and footer, rewrap to fit page
features.note: Header and Footer is a checked item under File (title top left, "Page n of m" bottom right). The Rewrap toggle is not done: the layout is always wrapped to the printable width.
features.wire: Add Header and Footer (title, page n of m) and Rewrap toggles to the print path in print.rs and as checked items under the Print submenu.

features.feature: Show/Hide document properties (author, title, subject, keywords, copyright)
features.apple: DocumentProperties.nib; Localizable: Show/Hide Properties, Change Author/Title/…
features.note: RTF reader skips the info group (rtf.rs:6).
features.wire: Read/write the RTF \info group in rtf.rs into TextDocument properties; add File > Show Properties opening a sheet with the fields.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Undo, Redo
features.note: Named undo actions.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Cut, Copy, Paste, Select All
Edit.nib: Edit > Paste and Match Style
features.note: Edit > Paste and Match Style (cmd+alt+shift+v) runs the paste path. The clipboard carries plain text only, so a paste already takes the style at the caret; rich pasteboard content will need a separate path.
features.wire: Add Edit > Paste and Match Style (cmd+alt+shift+v) inserting plain text with the caret style; Action variant in view.rs.

features.feature: Delete / Complete / Insert (page break, line break, paragraph break)
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Delete, Complete, Insert submenu
features.note: Edit > Delete and Edit > Complete (alt+escape) work: Complete offers the words of the document that start with the typed prefix and steps through them on repeat. Insert (page break, line break, paragraph break) is not done: the layout has no break characters other than the paragraph newline.
features.wire: Add Insert submenu items inserting break characters via insert_raw (main.rs:470); Complete = word completion from the document vocabulary.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Attach Files…, Link…
features.note: No attachments or links.
features.wire: Add a link attribute on cells in text.rs written as RTF \field HYPERLINK; Edit > Link… sheet; open via ctx.open_url on Cmd-click.

features.feature: Find, Find Next/Previous, Replace, Replace All
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Find submenu
features.note: Find bar with replace.

features.feature: Use Selection for Find / Jump to Selection
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Find > Use Selection for Find, Jump to Selection
features.note: Edit > Find > Use Selection for Find (cmd+E) fills the find field; Jump to Selection (cmd+J) scrolls the caret into view. The selection is not put on the shared find pasteboard.
features.wire: Add both to the Find group in edit_menu: Cmd+E copies the selection into self.find; Cmd+J scrolls to caret.

features.feature: Spelling: check now, while typing, learn, ignore, correct
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Spelling and Grammar
features.note: Correct Spelling Automatically replaces a misspelled word with the checker guess when a space or punctuation ends it (kept in the preferences). Still missing: grammar and the Show Spelling and Grammar panel.
features.wire: Add a "Correct Spelling Automatically" checked item applying spell.rs best guess on word end in type_into (main.rs:454); grammar is out of scope.

features.feature: Substitutions (smart quotes, dashes, links, text replacement, data detectors)
features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Substitutions; Preferences.nib: Smart quotes/dashes/links
features.note: Edit > Substitutions has Smart Quotes and Smart Dashes (curly quotes, -- to an em dash), applied while typing and kept in the preferences. Smart Links, Text Replacement and data detectors are not done.
features.wire: Add an Edit > Substitutions submenu with checked Smart Quotes / Smart Dashes; apply in type_into (main.rs:454) when typing quotes or "--"; persist in preferences.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Transformations
features.note: Edit > Transformations: Make Upper Case, Make Lower Case and Capitalize act on the selection as one undo entry.
features.wire: Add three items in edit_menu that replace the selection with its transformed string through the text.rs undoable replace.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Edit > Speech > Start/Stop Speaking
features.note: No TTS.
features.wire: Start/Stop Speaking items calling the SDK speech service with the selection or document.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Bold, Italic, Underline
features.note: Also in format bar.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Outline, Kern, Ligatures, Baseline
features.note: Strikethrough, Superscript and Subscript are character styles (RTF \strike \super \sub, HTML s/sup/sub, docx, odt, print). Outline, Kern and Ligatures are not done.
features.wire: Add strikethrough and super/subscript flags to the cell style in text.rs, RTF \strike \super \sub in rtf.rs, draw in view.rs; Format > Font items.

features.feature: Font family and size (Bigger/Smaller, Show Fonts)
features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Show Fonts, Bigger, Smaller
features.note: Fixed list of families (text::FAMILIES) and step sizes; no font panel with all system fonts.
features.wire: Replace the FAMILIES submenu with the SDK font panel (Cmd+T) listing installed fonts; store family name in cells.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Show Colours, Highlight
features.note: Format > Highlight sets a background colour from the palette (RTF \highlight, docx, odt, print). The colour panel for custom colours is not done.
features.wire: Add a highlight (background colour) attribute in text.rs with RTF \highlight/\cb; open SDK colour panel for custom colours.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Font > Copy Style, Paste Style
features.note: Format > Copy Style (cmd+alt+c) keeps the character formatting at the caret; Paste Style (cmd+alt+v) applies it to the selection or the typing style. Paragraph formatting is not copied.
features.wire: Store the caret style in the app on Copy Style; apply to the selection on Paste Style (format_menu).

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Text > Align Left/Centre/Justify/Right
Edit.nib: Format > Text > Spacing…
features.note: Preset line spacings only; no before/after paragraph spacing sheet.
features.wire: Add a Spacing… sheet with line height multiple and paragraph before/after values stored in paragraph props (text.rs:68).

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > List…
features.note: Bullets and numbers only; no list styles/prefix/start number.
features.wire: Add a List… sheet choosing marker style and start number; extend ListKind in text.rs.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Table…
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: kit model ui/src/text_table.rs (host tests) already provides this; the app does not use it yet.
features.wire: Add table blocks to the text model and RTF \trowd; lay out with bifrost_ui::text_table.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Text > Writing Direction
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: kit model ui/src/bidi.rs (host tests) already provides this; the app does not use it yet.
features.wire: Add a paragraph direction prop and run bifrost_ui::bidi in layout.rs; menu items under Text.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Text > Show Ruler, Copy Ruler, Paste Ruler; Preferences: Show ruler
features.note: View > Show Ruler / Hide Ruler (cmd+R) toggles the ruler and is kept in the preferences. Copy Ruler, Paste Ruler and first-line/left indent markers are not done.
features.wire: Add Format > Text > Show Ruler (cmd+r) toggling geometry(..., ruler) in main.rs:125; add first-line/left indent markers.

features.feature: Make Plain Text / Make Rich Text
features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Make Plain Text; Localizable: conversion confirms
features.note: No confirm when plain conversion loses formatting.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Prevent Editing / Allow Editing
features.note: Format > Prevent Editing / Allow Editing sets read_only on the window document: typing, deleting, paste, undo, replace, transformations and formatting refuse with a status note. It is not stored in the file.
features.wire: Add a read_only flag on TextDocument; Format > Prevent Editing toggles it; type_into/backspace/perform refuse edits when set.

features.feature: Wrap to Page / Wrap to Window
features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Wrap to Page; Localizable: Wrap to Window
features.note: View > Wrap to Window / Wrap to Page widens the text column to the window; kept in the preferences.
features.wire: Add a wrap mode to the layout width in ensure_layout (main.rs:187) and a Format item that switches between page and window width.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Allow Hyphenation
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: kit model ui/src/textbreak.rs (host tests) already provides this; the app does not use it yet.
features.wire: Use bifrost_ui::textbreak line-break opportunities plus soft hyphens in layout.rs.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Format > Make Vertical Layout
features.note: CJK vertical text layout; out of scope for current text stack.

features.apple: Edit.nib: View > Zoom In, Zoom Out, Actual Size
features.note: View > Zoom In (cmd+alt+=), Zoom Out (cmd+alt+-) and Actual Size (cmd+0) scale the text 50% to 400% (sizes are scaled for layout and drawing; the page width stays). Not checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add a View menu with Zoom In/Out/Actual Size scaling the page in view.rs geometry and draw_canvas (main.rs:837).

features.feature: Full screen and dark background for windows
features.apple: Edit.nib: View > Enter Full Screen, Use Dark Background for Windows
features.note: Full screen is shell window chrome; no dark page option.
features.wire: Add View > Use Dark Background for Windows toggling the page fill in view.rs.

features.apple: SelectLinePanel.nib, LinePanel strings
features.note: Edit > Find > Select Line... (cmd+L) selects a line or range such as 12-20 typed in the find field (the first press opens the find bar). There is no separate panel.
features.wire: Add Edit > Find > Select Line… (cmd+L) sheet taking "n" or "n-m" and selecting those lines via text.rs line index.

features.feature: Settings: new document format, window size, fonts
features.apple: Preferences.nib: New Document tab (format, wrap to page, window size, fonts)
features.note: No settings window API exists in the SDK, so a Preferences menu holds the new-document format (rich or plain) and the other options are kept in the preferences. Default fonts and window size in characters are not done.
features.wire: Add a Settings window (SDK settings pane): default rich/plain, default fonts, window width/height in characters; apply on New in the controller.

features.feature: Settings: open and save options (HTML/RTF as code, encodings, HTML saving, .txt extension)
features.apple: Preferences.nib: Open and Save tab
features.note: No settings.
features.wire: Add Open and Save pane: show HTML/RTF as code, default encodings, HTML doctype/CSS style, add .txt; consult them in document.rs read/write.

features.apple: Preferences.nib: Options (check spelling as you type, grammar, correct automatically, smart quotes/dashes/links)
features.note: Check Spelling While Typing, Correct Spelling Automatically, Smart Quotes, Smart Dashes, ruler, wrapping and print header/footer are saved to the preferences and restored at launch (main.rs configure). Exposed through the menus, not a settings window.
features.wire: Persist spelling.enabled and substitutions defaults in preferences and expose them in the Settings window.

features.feature: Services: new window with selection / open selected file
features.apple: Info.plist NSServices: New window containing selection; Open selected file
features.note: No services provider.
features.wire: Register two text services in the app manifest that create a new document with the text or open the named path through the controller; needs SDK services.

features.apple: Edit.nib: Help > TextEdit Help
features.note: Apple help book content.
